answer: Tenure-weighted voting with quadratic voice: an identity's say scales with the square root of continuously active epochs and is capped, so a thousand fresh puppets cast barely more weight than a veteran. Ballots are public, and a pulse of identical votes from a cluster of keys triggers review of the shared custody line. A farm must keep puppets alive for years, paying upkeep. Weight accrues on a crystal-clear slow calendar, not the wallet: the reference kernel recomputes every ballot from verified epoch history, so newcomers need only patience.
